result.title: Adaptive Mean Estimation by In-Context Learning: A Gradient-Flow Analysis
result.summary: Prior Fitted Networks (PFNs) such as TabPFN now rival established statistical procedures across prediction and estimation tasks. A natural explanation is that PFNs have the property of statistical adaptivity, that is, they perform nearly as well as a method tailored to the true data-generating model for a heterogeneous set of models, while not being told which model the data comes from. We study how such adaptivity is learned in a controlled location-estimation problem. Each task is an unlabeled sample whose family is hidden: Gaussian data call for averaging, with error of order $n^{-1}$, whereas uniform data are best estimated from their extremes, at the faster rate $n^{-2}$. We also provide the example of a symmetric Gaussian mixture, for which a rate of $σ^2_n/n$ can be attained. On scalar inputs, softmax attention computes the derivative of the empirical cumulant-generating function. A single primitive therefore both supplies features that distinguish the families and forms estimators interpolating between the sample mean and the mid-range. We combine attention experts through either a softmax mixture of experts or a gated linear unit (GLU), and analyze stagewise gradient flow. With $\widetildeΩ(n^{1+ε})$ pretraining tasks, the learned estimator is asymptotically efficient on Gaussian tasks, within a factor $n^ε$ of the minimax rate on uniform tasks, and order-optimal on mixtures in a shrinking-variance regime. These guarantees extend to new locations and longer contexts. A risk decomposition separates expert error, routing error and normalization error, which clarifies the architectural contrast. Softmax gating enforces normalization and exact translation equivariance, whereas the GLU must learn it: its dynamics separate into fast bias removal followed by slow expert selection. End-to-end experiments recover the predicted specialization.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在受控位置估计任务上分析 PFN/TabPFN 如何通过 in-context learning 学得统计自适应性：softmax 注意力被解释为经验累积生成函数的导数，并通过专家混合或 GLU 组合形成在样本均值与 mid-range 间插值的估计器，给出梯度流的阶段式分析与效率保证。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作不涉及视觉或多模态推理，但其对注意力作为估计器、专家路由与阶段式梯度流的分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态如何随上下文自适应选择与更新提供理论线索，可供核查。
